summary: Fortuna Mining Corp., a Canadian foreign private issuer listed on NYSE and TSX, filed a Form 6-K on October 20, 2026, furnishing a news release reporting infill drilling results at its Lindero gold mine in Argentina. The 31-hole, 8,534-meter program returned intercepts including 0.96 g/t Au over 350 meters in hole LDH-272 and 0.85 g/t Au over 236 meters in LDH-259, extending mineralization below the current life-of-mine pit design. Results are being incorporated into an updated block model and pit design targeted by year-end, supporting a revised LOM plan and Mineral Reserve estimate. No transactional or special-situation element is present; the filing is routine operational disclosure.
